title: Peoria PlayHouse Children's Museum

services.name: Field trips
services.desc: Our mission at the Peoria PlayHouse Children’s Museum is to provide children with the tools and inspiration they need to be explorers and creators of the world and our field trip experiences accomplish just that! Whether you are bringing your group to simply explore and play in the many exhibits here at our museum during a PlayHouse Adventure Field Trip or choose a Spotlight Field Trip with play time PLUS a specially curated STEAM classroom workshop, your students will be sure to have an amazing experience imagining, exploring, and creating here at the Peoria PlayHouse Children’s Museum.
